summary: Executed full backend + frontend testing for LÀ·BA restaurant site. Backend: 4/4 pytest cases passing (health, reservation create+persistence, validation, guests bounds). Frontend: Hero loads with LÀ·BA title, 'Art of Dining' tagline, both CTA buttons. Language toggle correctly switches document dir=rtl and back to ltr. Navbar links smooth-scroll to sections (Lenis working). All 8 menu tabs exist and switching between them updates content correctly (Coffee shows 'Single Espresso' SAR 18; Restaurant shows 'LÀ.BA Signature Tomahawk'). Gallery item click opens lightbox. WhatsApp floating button links to wa.me/966582266333. Empty reservation submit shows validation toast ('Please fill all required fields'). Filled reservation POSTs to /api/reservations returning 200 and displays success toast 'Reservation received — opening WhatsApp to confirm.'

issues: Uses browser-native date input (mm/dd/yyyy) and native time input instead of shadcn Calendar/Time components. Guidance recommends shadcn calendar for consistent luxury design.

action_items: Optional: Replace native date/time inputs in Contact.jsx reservation form with shadcn Calendar + Popover time selector to match luxury aesthetic.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: reservations endpoint uses response_model=Reservation which is good. created_at stored as ISO string then re-parsed on GET — acceptable but consider storing as native datetime consistently.
No pagination on GET /api/reservations (to_list(1000)) — fine for MVP.
CORS uses env var with '*' fallback — acceptable.
seed_data_creation: Created 1 TEST_-prefixed reservation via backend test, 1 via frontend automation flow.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py; run via pytest --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml. Site uses Lenis smooth scroll (window.__lenis). Reservation POST returns 200 with Reservation object. Language toggle uses [data-testid=lang-toggle]. Menu tabs [data-testid=menu-tab-<key>] and menu-detail contain items. Lightbox close animation may take >500ms; use longer wait if verifying close.
